PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.section1_content: This privacy policy informs you about the nature, scope, and purpose of the processing of personal data on our website.
PrivacyPage.section3_hosting_content: This website runs on a server rented from Hetzner Online GmbH, Gunzenhausen, Germany. Each time the website is accessed, the web server automatically records technical information (such as IP address, date and time, requested page and browser type) in server log files. This data is used only to operate and secure the website and is not merged with other data sources. The legal basis is our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) in a secure and reliable website. Portfolio photos are loaded from our own self-hosted Nextcloud server; your browser never connects to it directly.
PrivacyPage.section3_analytics_content: We use Umami, an open-source analytics tool that we host ourselves. Umami does not use cookies, does not store IP addresses and does not create user profiles; it only records anonymous, aggregated usage statistics (such as page views and referring websites). No data is passed on to third parties. The legal basis is our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) in analysing and improving our website.
PrivacyPage.section3_contact_content: When you use our contact form, your name, email address and message are sent to us by email via our email provider dogado GmbH, Dortmund, Germany, and you receive an automatic confirmation email. We use this data only to answer your request and delete it once it is no longer needed. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) and, where your request concerns a booking, the performance of pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Requests sent with “Plan your shoot” on the sessions page are additionally stored in the content management system on our own server so that we can follow up on them; they are deleted once they are no longer needed.
PrivacyPage.section3_spam_content: To protect our forms against automated abuse, we use a hidden form field and limit the number of submissions per IP address. For this purpose your IP address is held only temporarily in the working memory of our server (for at most one hour) and is not stored permanently. No third-party service is involved. The legal basis is our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) in preventing spam and abuse.
PrivacyPage.section3_testimonials_content: If you use our form to submit a testimonial, the data you provide (name, organisation/event, your review, ratings and optionally an uploaded photo) is stored in the content management system that runs on our own server, for the purpose of reviewing and publishing your feedback on our website. The processing is based on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you give by submitting the form. You can withdraw this consent at any time by contacting us, and your testimonial will be removed.
PrivacyPage.section4_title: 3. Your Rights as a Data Subject
PrivacyPage.section4_content: Within the framework of the applicable legal provisions, you have the right at any time to free information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients, and the purpose of the data processing, and, if applicable, a right to correction or deletion of this data.
